Mr. Sudds had a blunt force injury to his head.
He was shot at least twice, once in the head.
Mr. Sudds was hit over the head, shot and killed very shortly after getting into the vehicle with Mr. Glasgow and Mr. Whynder
rationale_highlights: custodial conditions during COVID, the impact of understaffing on remanded inmates (about which I take judicial notice), and the documented systemic racism within federal institutions (about which the Crown made no comment), are appropriate factors to consider when determining the proper period of parole ineligibility

but also considering his very challenging background as described in the IRCA, the systemic racism he faces in the federal penitentiary system (according to the Commission Report) and the time he spent on remand during COVID, the appropriate period for parole ineligibility is 16 years
note: IRCA content itself is in paras 20-24, not in passage.
